Vijay's film 'Jana Nayagan' achieves significant box office milestones

Thalapathy Vijay's film 'Jana Nayagan' has achieved significant box office success, crossing ₹150 crore in India and ₹250 crore globally within its first week. The film has also reportedly entered the ₹200 crore club worldwide in its extended first weekend. Director H. Vinoth has hinted at an extended version of the film, which may include six deleted scenes and is slated for release next week. In Tamil Nadu, 'Jana Nayagan' has crossed ₹100 crore, setting a new record for Vijay.
